ui.核弹级方案：\n1. NtOpenProcess 兜底覆盖受保护进程（解决 Op:
The nuclear option:
1. Fall back to NtOpenProcess for protected processes (works around "OpenProcess access denied")
2. Suspend every non-critical process → hard-cap its working set to 1 byte
3. Allocate large blocks to create extreme memory pressure → force the kernel to trim
4. Flush the standby list repeatedly to release physical RAM

While it runs: background windows may freeze briefly (processes are suspended),
and everything resumes automatically afterwards.

If you use a mechanical hard drive: switching windows may stutter badly because
pages must be re-read from disk. SSD users usually notice nothing.

Protected: the foreground window, explorer, dwm, csrss, lsass and other core processes.

Continue?

The team shares a common context space and can call the create-cordis skill to extend core files and register sub Agents.
